analysis.object_validation_protocol: OBJECT_IDENTITY_GPU_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL defines same_object=0.97, role thresholds, and reference_bank recall rules; evidence collection binds measurable scores without GPU execution.
analysis.object_dataset_plan: OBJECT_IDENTITY_GPU_VALIDATION_DATASET_PLAN provides easy/medium/hard and role case seeds; evidence dataset extends with stress_batch for occlusion and zoom perturbations.
analysis.object_reference_bank: Bank entries (suitcase_001, chair_014, lantern_001, wooden_crate_001) supply reference_bank_id, identity_signature, and anchor_descriptors for evidence record templates.
analysis.object_similarity_binding: object_similarity_v1 same_object_threshold=0.97 governs evidence scoring; similar_object scores must not be classified as definitive evidence.
analysis.object_role_binding: object_role_v1 assigns hero_prop > scene_prop priority; role thresholds govern pass threshold tier per evidence batch.
analysis.object_traceability_binding: traceability_signature links conditioning_map_ref and OBJECT_REFERENCE_BANK_SPECIFICATION for batch audit without GPU execution.

object_evidence_contract.scope: Evidence definition only — Evidence Defined != Evidence Collected.
object_evidence_contract.gpu_execution: false — evidence protocol and dataset only; collection deferred.
object_evidence_contract.gpu_authorization: false — evidence_sufficient_for_gpu_authorization must remain false until execution phase.
object_evidence_contract.texture_match_note: Texture Match is part of Object Identity — texture_drift is a first-class object failure mode.
object_evidence_contract.assessment_note: Evidence Collected != Object Validated; Object Validated != Movie Reconstruction Ready.

object_measurement_rules.identity_signature_match_score: Primary measurement from identity_signature hash equality against reference bank.
object_measurement_rules.texture_match_score: Surface texture consistency against anchor_images metadata descriptors.
object_measurement_rules.anchor_recall_score: Count of anchor_descriptors kind+importance matches >= minimum_anchor_match.
object_measurement_rules.role_weight_score: Narrative lock weight derived from object_role_binding role priority.
object_measurement_rules.object_traceability_score: Traceability signature match against conditioning_map_ref and bank spec path.
object_measurement_rules.measurement_note: All measurements are schema-defined; no GPU raster comparison in this phase.

object_scoring_rules.pass_threshold: composite_evidence_score >= 0.97 required for same-object evidence tier.
object_scoring_rules.false_positive_penalty: Scores above pass_threshold on different_object cases trigger false_positive audit.

object_evidence_levels.note: Definitive object evidence; composite score >= 0.97 with texture_match >= 0.90.
Strict band; sufficient for anchor tuning review but not identity lock.
Similar object band; logged for degradation path only.
Below different_object threshold; evidence record rejected.

object_traceability_rules.traceability_signature: Must bind object_id, reference_bank_id, identity_signature, and object_spec_ref.
object_traceability_rules.identity_signature_integrity: identity_signature must resolve to bank spec entry; mismatch triggers traceability failure.
object_traceability_rules.batch_audit_path: Evidence records written to OBJECT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_DATASET.json batches for offline review.
object_traceability_rules.role_binding_cross_ref: object_role_binding role must align with batch tier (hero_prop_batch, secondary_prop_batch, background_object_batch).

object_identity_tiers.note: Hero Prop Defined != Hero Prop Preserved — suitcase_001 requires highest lock.
Maps to scene_prop and environment_prop roles in object_role_v1 binding.
Maps to background_furniture role; permits higher variation within band.

reference_bank_recall_rules.recall_method: Match evidence record anchors against reference bank anchor_descriptors; count kind+importance matches >= minimum_anchor_match.
